title: Sales Overview
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Orders
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

density.rule: a monthly line of events, company totals
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))

SELECT count(DISTINCT l.product_id) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
